sources: T.S. Kelso, 'Frequently Asked Questions: Two-Line Element Set Format', Satellite Times, January 1998: 'Two-digit years from 57-99 correspond to 1957-1999 and those from 00-56 correspond to 2000-2056.' https://celestrak.org/columns/v04n03/
python-sgp4 io.py implements the same pivot (year < 57 -> +2000)
resolution_note: 1e-8 day = 0.000864 s; an 8-decimal day fraction always converts to an exact whole number of microseconds.
international_designator_note: The TLE international designator also carries a two-digit launch year (columns 10-11); no document defines its century mapping. This corpus applies the same 57 pivot (see ambiguity object-id-launch-year-pivot).
